ideas.pitch: An IoT and mobile companion app providing real-time audio-haptic navigation and low-floor bus seat availability specifically for wheelchair users and visually impaired commuters.
ideas.problem_statement: Disability-centric innovation, accessibility, assistive technology, and digital inclusion at SAARTHI'26.
ideas.title: SaathiCommute: Accessible Public Transit Companion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core disability-centric theme of SAARTHI with tangible social impact and localized public transit integration.

ideas.pitch: An edge-AI running on a cheap microcontroller or local mobile app that translates dysarthric or impaired speech into clear synthesized speech in real time without needing cloud connectivity.
ideas.problem_statement: Inclusive, accessible, scalable solutions to real-world challenges supporting persons with disabilities.
ideas.title: AuraVocal: Offline Edge-AI Speech Clarifier for Cerebral Palsy
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes hard engineering (edge ML model fine-tuning) combined with high-empathy social impact, which stands out heavily to academic and IEEE judges.

ideas.pitch: A computer-vision-based web application that tracks hand signs via standard webcams and provides real-time gamified corrections for teachers and students learning Indian Sign Language (ISL).
ideas.problem_statement: Inclusive education, accessibility, and disability-centric digital inclusion.
ideas.title: EduSign-VR: Interactive Sign Language Learning Bridge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses inclusive education and digital inclusion, directly mirroring previous successful editions of SAARTHI focused on disability-centric solutions.

ideas.pitch: A multilingual voice-first triage and preventive care assistant designed for rural and semi-urban hill regions with low connectivity, offering localized health awareness and emergency dispatch hints.
ideas.problem_statement: Technology-driven, inclusive, accessible, and impactful solutions to real-world healthcare challenges.
ideas.title: MedReach-Rural: Multilingual Medical Triage for Mountain Terrains
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly appeals to the local context of Uttarakhand (mountainous terrain and regional access hurdles) which regional judges at GEHU value deeply.

ideas.pitch: A student-built IoT sensor rig and mapping dashboard that automatically audits institutional ramps, tactile paving blocks, and elevators for compliance with disability accessibility standards.
ideas.problem_statement: Assistive technology, accessibility, IoT, and digital inclusion.
ideas.title: SmartAssist-Campus: IoT Accessibility Auditing Tool
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines physical IoT prototyping with software dashboards, making it an interactive hardware-software hybrid that is rare and impressive at regional hackathons.
